notifications.text: The mound cracks! A Storage Chest and a Solar Refinery tumble out — check the Shop. The Refinery runs on sunlight, so try refining some Bio-Sludge into Biomass for turret ammo!
Another crack spreads wider. A Collector tumbles out, closely followed by an Electric Eel that looks personally offended by the mess.

The mound stops cracking and just gives up, shattering completely. Underneath: a Science Lab that has apparently been there the whole time, humming with unfinished research. Everything from here on out is going to cost Science.
Psst — drag one of those onto another of the same kind and it'll copy its recipe over. Beats picking it twice.
Something's stirring out past the reef... probably nothing.
Not sure what to do next? Check the Achievements tab (🎖️) — it's full of ideas for how to keep growing your tank.
Uh oh, I'm reading movement out there. Get your turrets ready.
Aliens incoming! Click 'em for 1 damage a pop, or let a turret handle it. While they're alive they'll poop waste and scare nearby fish off their coins, so don't dawdle.
Psst — aliens are suckers for a free meal. Toss down some Food and watch 'em beeline for it instead of your fish.
Ooh, fresh Bio-Sludge! You've already got a Solar Refinery sitting there looking useful — throw it in and see what dribbles out the other end.
Uh oh, I'm picking up movement again. Get your turrets ready.
Careful now, food that's chilling too long rots into waste
